configuration.authNotes: Bearer token is only required when the customer's inlet has authentication enabled (Adobe returns 401/403 only for authenticated inlets). Tokens expire every 24 hours. Scopes and token endpoint not confirmed.

authImplementation.refresh: custom refreshAccessToken doing a client_credentials request with the customer's own client ID/secret (not oauth-managed)
authImplementation.extendRequest: Authorization: Bearer plus x-api-key; must not send a bad header when credentials are absent on an unauthenticated inlet
authImplementation.reauth: core refreshes the token and retries on a 401 in an HTTP response or in a multistatus entry (MAX_ATTEMPTS bound); it keys on 401 only, so map Adobe 403 (invalid/expired token) to 401 in the per-message status
unknown: whether clientId/clientSecret are optional for unauthenticated inlets

settings.name: clientSecret

background.streamingIngestion: Sends XDM-formatted JSON records over HTTP to a customer-created inlet; records land in an AEP dataset that CJA reads. Latency under 60 min to data lake, under 15 min to Real-Time Customer Profile if profile-enabled.

headers: Authorization: Bearer {ACCESS_TOKEN} (only for inlets with authorization enabled)
headerSchemaOptional: createdAt (Adobe: automatically generated; appears in the tutorial example)
request.specDiscrepancy: Adobe's tutorial example shows only Authorization and Content-Type headers and omits flowId; the OpenAPI reference spec requires x-sandbox-name and flowId. Blueprint follows the reference; confirm on a live inlet.
limits: No documented max message count per request
All messages in a request must be same org and sandbox; may target different datasets and schemas

response.status: 207 Multi-Status for success, partial success and failure
response.handling: Check each entry in responses[]; resend only failed messages

statusCodes.403: invalid or expired token (authenticated inlets only)
statusCodes.500: internal/processing error (Adobe tutorial gives schema mismatch as an example; assumed to be 400 instead)
statusCodes.503: retry at least 3 times with exponential backoff

terms.xdm: Adobe's JSON schema format; each dataset is tied to one schema
terms.inlet: Customer-created streaming connection endpoint; ID is the CONNECTION_ID
terms.sandbox: Isolated partition of an org; the inlet belongs to one sandbox

fields.name: imsOrgId

fields.name: sourceName

fields.name: ecid

fields.name: pid
fields.validation: at least one valid identity required across ecid/pid/customIdentities; else rejected 400 PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_FAILED (Q5)

fields.name: customIdentities

fields.name: xdmMapping
fields.transform: build nested JSON from XDM paths; drop/flag non-conforming fields

fields.name: enable_batching
fields.description: Enable batching of events to /collection/batch

fields.name: batch_bytes
fields.validation: must stay below the 1 MB hard limit with headroom; unsafe_hidden true
fields.description: Maximum batch payload size in bytes

fields.name: batch_keys
fields.description: Default ['imsOrgId','sandboxName','inletId']: per-request values (URL path and x-sandbox-name header), so events with different values never share a batch

considerations: Wrap each mapped XDM record in header + body.xdmMeta + body.xdmEntity; schemaRef must be identical in header and xdmMeta
Identity mapping builds identityMap inside xdmEntity; not a separate action
Property mapping targets XDM paths, not fixed eVar slots
207 is returned for success, partial success and failure: read responses[] per message and retry only failures
performBatch MUST return a MultiStatusResponse (from @segment/actions-core); any other return value makes the platform assume the whole batch succeeded and silently swallows Adobe's 207 failures
One HTTP request; loop over responses[] and match entry n to payload n by index into the payloads passed to performBatch (validation failures are filtered upstream)

Use setSuccessResponseAtIndex(i, {status, sent, body}) and setErrorResponseAtIndex(i, {status, errormessage, sent, body}); include sent and body on API errors so they are attributed to the destination; templates: rokt-capi/send/functions.ts, ms-bing-capi/sendEvent, quora/trackConversion, amazon-conversions-api/trackConversion
Property mapping UI: object field with additionalProperties true and defaultObjectUI 'keyvalue' (customer types the XDM path); 'object' UI is an alternative; offer flat dotted paths as default

Core has no dotted-key-to-nested-JSON helper: write a unit-tested setPath in the destination with collision handling (later key wins vs PayloadValidationError) and rejection of __proto__, constructor and prototype keys since keys are customer-entered

Ship manual XDM path entry in P0; Schema Registry introspection is P1 (dynamic dropdown of schemas for schemaRefId plus path validation); dynamic fields give choice lists not per-key autocomplete and no dependsOn between dynamic fields was found

Batching is chunked by the platform before performBatch: set batch_bytes hidden with headroom (about 800-900 KB) and guard in code, reporting a single oversized message's index as 413; examples: aws-kinesis/send, altertable/identify
No documented max message count per request
Failed messages are stored in an error batch in the target dataset
Lift-and-shift (Analytics ExperienceEvent Full Extension) handled via xdmMapping presets, no separate action
Schema Registry introspection desired for path suggestions and conformance flags
Late/future timestamp handling unresolved
Throughput conflict: Adobe lists 10,000 messages/sec vs PRD target of 25-30k events/sec (see throughputConcern)

errorHandling.207: inspect responses[]; success entries have xactionId, failures have statusCode and message; report each failure at its index via MultiStatusResponse; resend only failures
errorHandling.400: report as error 400; not retried (core does not retry 400)
errorHandling.401: missing auth header (authenticated inlets only); report as 401 so core refreshes the token and retries
errorHandling.403: invalid/expired token (authenticated inlets only); MAP TO 401 in the per-message status, otherwise core's refresh does not fire
errorHandling.413: report as error 413; not retried; should not occur with byte-bounded batching
errorHandling.500: internal/processing error: treated as transient and retried (decision: a schema mismatch is assumed to be 400, not retried; verify in a live org)
errorHandling.503: report as error 503; retried; Adobe advises at least 3 retries with exponential backoff

actions.retryNote: Core retryable statuses (core/src/errors.ts:28): 408, 423, 429, 500, 502-511, 598, 599. Per-entry multistatus retry is done by a platform component outside this repo; confirm with the platform team (Q13).

resolvedQuestions: Q1: endpoint is POST https://dcs.adobedc.net/collection/batch/{CONNECTION_ID}; the connection ID is the customer's inlet ID (inletId action field)
Q3: schemaRef (id + contentType), datasetId, imsOrgId and flowId are required per message header (Adobe reference spec); modeled as action-level fields

flowId (previously missing from this blueprint): required in the message header per Adobe's reference spec; it is the ID of the dataflow; added as a required action-level field on both actions plus optional source.name; enforcement and best placement remain open (Q12, Q15)
Q11 sandboxName: x-sandbox-name is a required header on both ingestion operations, so sandboxName is a required action field sent on every request
operations header field: not present in the reference spec; dropped
Auth necessity: 401/403 are returned only for inlets with authentication enabled, so the Bearer token is only needed for authenticated inlets
resolvedByRepoResearch: Multi-status handling: performBatch must return a MultiStatusResponse or 207 failures are silently treated as success
Q10 scheme: oauth2 with custom refreshAccessToken (client_credentials), not oauth-managed; map Adobe 403 to 401 so core's refresh fires (token URL, scope and auth-optional behavior remain open)

Q6 nested JSON/UI: key-value object field plus a destination-owned dotted-path helper with collision and prototype-key guards (schema choice lift-and-shift vs clean semantic remains a product decision)
Batching design: hidden batch_bytes with headroom plus per-message oversize guard
Q11 (partly): dynamic fields give schema pickers, not per-key autocomplete, so P0 is manual path entry and introspection is P1
Q13 (mostly): retryable status set known and per-message mapping proposed; per-entry retry owner remains; 500 decision made (schema mismatch assumed 400, 500 retried as transient)

Q12 (decision): settings are only clientId and clientSecret; imsOrgId, sandboxName, inletId, schemaRefId, schemaRefContentType, datasetId and flowId are action fields; testAuthentication checks credentials only (token fetch); Q15 still covers flowId vs inlet
openQuestions: Q2: Profile enrichment path: per-event enrichment vs CJA query-time join (decides whether upsertProfile ships)
Q4: resolved (Adobe docs): same batch endpoint and envelope for profile records; profile dataset must be Profile- and Identity-enabled

Q5: resolved (decision): drop blank identities; exactly one primary (custom flagged, else PID, else first custom, else ECID); no valid identity means the event is rejected with a per-message 400 PAYLOAD_VALIDATION_FAILED before sending, not retried; confirm in a live org
Q6: XDM schema approach (lift-and-shift vs clean semantic): product decision (nested JSON UI support is resolved)
Q7: Is ECI-based cross-device stitching depended upon; ECI namespace config in Identity Service
Q8: Handling of severely out-of-order timestamps; keep late/future blocking logic?

Q9: resolved (Adobe docs): ExperienceEvent class requires _id (sender-generated, hash of messageId) and timestamp (past, from 1970); msgType/msgId/xdmSchema form is only an invalid example, not supported

Q10: OAuth token endpoint URL and scope (not answerable from the repo); are clientId/clientSecret optional for unauthenticated inlets (if so required false and extendRequest must not send a bad header); which header carries the Client ID (x-api-key). Scheme is resolved: oauth2 + refreshAccessToken
Q11: plan is manual path entry in P0 and introspection in P1 (per-key autocomplete would be a UI-team ask); the sandboxName half is resolved (required ingestion header)
Q12: resolved (decision): org, sandbox and inlet are action fields; settings are only clientId and clientSecret

Q15: flowId: how does a customer find it, is it enforced in practice (Adobe's tutorial example omits it), and is a flow tied one-to-one to an inlet (making it an inlet-level setting)? Adobe describes it only as the ID of the dataflow when the account has been used to create multiple dataflows

Q13: Which platform component retries individual multistatus entries (outside this repo; confirm with the platform team); decision made: schema mismatch assumed to be 400 (not retried), 500 retried as transient; verify in a live org
Q14: Throughput conflict: Adobe's 10,000 messages/sec vs the PRD's 25-30k events/sec target; confirm entitlements with Adobe

The reference spec was read from Adobe's docs repo (a static file that may lag the live reference page); re-check flowId and the headers against the rendered API reference when AEP access is available
eVar/prop remapping acknowledgement for existing Adobe Analytics customers (migration concern)
Group and Alias are not covered by the PRD (events and profile only)
